args.summary: Built `compress.py`, a stdlib-only compressor/decompressor that losslessly packs the corpus’s hexadecimal, base-36, and structured metadata lines before zlib compression. Verified the CLI round trip byte-for-byte; the compressed file is 18,434 bytes versus the 44,267-byte corpus (58.36% size reduction), beating default zlib’s 22,390 bytes. The registered round-trip assay passed stably at 58.3572.
